Method of Attack: Disguised as a Windows junk cleaner tool to trick users into installing it
Downloads and executes a malware component that steals browser passwords, FTP client passwords, cryptocurrency wallets, desktop files, and other sensitive data
Communicates with a Command & Control server via gate.php script
Uploads harvested data in an Encrypted.zip file before self-removal
Attack Vector: Fake website distributing a malicious Windows utility
